name: pagepulse
description: Evidence-first monitoring for meaningful changes on public webpages.
author: Manpreet Singh

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.test:eval: npm run test -w server -- test/integration.test.ts -t "evaluation suite"
